mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, chain, tx_hash, amount, confirmations, status, created_at, credited_at FROM wallet_deposit ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: SELECT w.id, w.user_id, w.amount, w.fee, w.network, w.address, w.status, w.delay_ends_at, w.created_at, w.reviewer_id, w.reject_reason, w.tx_hash, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_withdrawal p WHERE p.user_id = w.user_id AND p.network = w.network AND p.id < w.id AND p.status IN ('BROADCASTING', 'COMPLETED') AND (CASE WHEN w.network = 'TRC20' THEN p.address = w.address ELSE LOWER(p.address) = LOWER(w.address) END)) AS first_use, (SELECT MAX(l.created_at) FROM wallet_whitelist l WHERE l.user_id = w.user_id AND l.network = w.network AND l.address_key = (CASE WHEN w.network = 'TRC20' THEN w.address ELSE LOWER(w.address) END)) AS whitelist_added_at FROM wallet_withdrawal w
mapper.select: ORDER BY w.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM wallet_withdrawal WHERE status IN ('COOLING', 'REVIEWING', 'DELAYED') GROUP BY status
SELECT 'COMPLETED' AS status, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM wallet_withdrawal WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND completed_at >= #{since}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM wallet_deposit WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'CREDITED'
SELECT 'CREDITED' AS status, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM wallet_deposit WHERE status = 'CREDITED' AND credited_at >= #{since}
